display_long_description:
🦍 WELCOME TO CHIMPORIA! 🦍

Experience the Gorilla Locomotion System where YOU are the controller! Swing, climb, and leap through stunning environments using nothing but your hands. The game that feels natural and exhilarating !

🌟 MASTER THE ART OF MOVEMENT 🌟

Chimporia revolutionizes VR locomotion with hand-powered physics. Push off surfaces, build momentum, and launch yourself across vibrant worlds. The more you play, the better you become—mastering advanced techniques like wall-running, precision jumps, and speed boosting.

🎮 KEY FEATURES 🎮

✅ INTUITIVE HAND-BASED LOCOMOTION
Move naturally using your hands to push, climb, and swing. No complicated controls—if you can move your arms, you can play!

✅ MULTIPLAYER MAYHEM
Join players from around the world in competitive matches and casual hangouts. Make friends, form teams, and create unforgettable moments.

✅ PROXIMITY VOICE CHAT
Communicate naturally with nearby players using spatial audio. The closer you are, the clearer you hear—just like real life!

✅ STUNNING ENVIRONMENTS
Explore colorful, hand-crafted maps designed for maximum fun. From sprawling forests to futuristic cities, every location offers unique challenges.

✅ BEGINNER FRIENDLY
Easy to learn, hard to master. Tutorial mode helps newcomers get started, while
